Media-WebSocket capability token — services/telephony/ws_auth.py
the carrier dials the media socket back, so its URL is caller-visible: the provider signs it and the handler verifies
token travels in the URL path (never the query string) and stays redacted in logs
TELEPHONY_WS_TOKEN_SECRET → log-only · TELEPHONY_WS_TOKEN_ENFORCE=true → reject
